title: A development dream linked to Ravana’s birthplace
content: In Greater Noida’s Bisrakh, where Dasara passes without the burning of Ravana’s effigy, the priests of two temples that are barely 300 metres apart claim that their temple stands at the exact spot where the Ramayana’s demon-king was born. Ishita Mishra finds that as the priests vie for Ravana’s legacy, residents hope that a story passed down through generations will bring their village recognition, roads, footfall, and funds

title: Social security, welfare fund board pensions in Keralam to be distributed from October 26

title: Kerala Police book social media influencer Darren for ‘communally divisive hate speech’ on Instagram
content: Social media influencer Diya Krishna, daughter of BJP leader and NTDFC chairperson G. Krishnan Kumar, says she seconded Darren’s post as a ‘sad reality’ without watching the full video; Darren also criticised UDF govt. for ‘accepting funding from Arab countries to aid promote Islam’ in Keralam; Satheesan, Pinarayi slam the video

title: Residents flag safety risk as silt removed from canals piles up along city roads

content: Iran Air not allowed to fly medicines directly from India to Tehran, due to fear of U.S. sanctions; India says medicines can be taken through a third country; Tehran says humanitarian aid is exempted from sanctions

title: MHA employing tools of fear, intimidation and threats in Ladakh: Kargil Democratic Alliance

title: A distant Pacific phenomenon may be drying India’s north, says study

content: In a representation to the Department of Pharmaceuticals, the group urges the government to replace  Medanta chairman with a member free of potential conflicts of interest.

content: Absence of officials despite being summoned amounts to breach of privilege, Congress leader and panel chair Venugopal tells Speaker seeking appropriate action

content: 600 master trainers to be trained in first phase; programme aims to equip 60,000 civil defence volunteers across 12 States and Union Territories with emergency response skills

content: Farmer IDs are expected to enable ‘transparent, efficient and timely’ access for farmers to government schemes, bank credit, crop insurance, and disaster relief

title: ISRO will not be privatised, says chairperson Narayanan
content: Contributions from private companies should not be misinterpreted as privatisation of the space agency, says the chairperson

title: Commuters wait through multiple signal cycles at junctions along Old Madras Road

content: The weather system over Bay of Bengal is likely to intensify into a deep depression on Sunday and into a cyclonic storm by Monday morning and is expected to make landfall on October 28

title: ‘No line he will not cross’: Obama slams Ramaswamy’s ‘cruel’ ad, hits out at Trump
content: Obama focused much of his criticism on Republican gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy, who has continued to defend an advertisement featuring the estranged mother of his Democratic rival, Dr Amy Acton. Trump and vice president JD Vance have also defended the campaign, despite calls from prominent Ohio Republicans, including Governor Mike DeWine, to withdraw it.

title: No EC nod needed for voter to sue candidate over false information: Supreme Court
content: A bench of Justices Dipankar Datta and Sheel Nagu quashed the Karnataka HC order which had held that “right given to the voter is only to file an election petition, and not to register a private complaint of crime which is the duty of the Election Commission, if it wants to do so”.

title: Protests sweep France, Spain as masked mobs loot shops, clash with cops; 1,100 held
content: Videos shared online showed people trapped inside shops, including the department store El Corte Ingles, after shutters were lowered to prevent looting. Other footage showed hooded demonstrators dressed in black smashing shop windows and taking goods, sometimes encouraged by people watching online. Barcelona Mayor Jaume Collboni warned that acts of vandalism "will not go unpunished".

title: Farooq Abdullah's comments on Pakistan and Kashmir draw flak
content: Farooq urged NC workers and legislators to remain loyal to the party, whether in power or not, as he touched on a range of issues in his speech. “Hold on to the truth. Speaking the truth is not easy, but unless you remain truthful and stand up for what is right, your future will never be secure,” the veteran said.

title: Princess’s gambit: At 11, Bodhana Sivanandan is an international master
content: Sivanandan, who lives in the London suburb of Harrow, broke the 38-year-old record held by Hungarian chess legend Judit Polgar, widely regarded as the greatest female player in chess history, after winning her final-round game at the European Women’s Club Cup in Budva, Montenegro on Friday. Polgar had qualified at the age of 12 in 1988.

title: Michael and Susan Dell’s foundation spotlights free skills training in Texas
content: The Michael & Susan Dell Foundation has reported remarkable achievements among graduates of its skilled-trades training initiatives. Over a dedicated five-week course crafted with input from employers, participants secure jobs almost immediately. Success stories like Mariah showcase a transition into well-paying, stable careers, while Skillpoint Alliance is enhancing training capacities to address Texas's rising need for skilled workers, ultimately promoting economic growth and assisting businesses in meeting workforce challenges.

title: Interview | ‘AAP had 4.5 years to end drug menace, gangsterism in Punjab’: Pilot
content: "BJP has no strong footing in Punjab and has survived on the back of SAD support. But SAD has also split and is facing internal issues. It is not the force like they were under Badal Senior. It will be a bipolar contest over who can lead Punjab better. There will be other players like Amritpal Singh’s party, but people of Punjab don’t give a fractured mandate," Sachin Pilot said.

title: New York court upholds foreclosure dismissal after lender waited 3 years
content: In a significant ruling, a New York appeals court has supported the dismissal of a mortgage foreclosure lawsuit against a borrower after the lender delayed three years to seek a default judgment. New York regulations stipulate that lenders must act within one year of a borrower's non-response to avoid case dismissal. This decision reinforces homeowner protections and emphasizes the importance of timely legal actions in foreclosure matters.

title: Trump votes in Florida midterms, defends controversial ad, doubles down on Iran
content: Trump and first lady Melania Trump arrived together at a polling station at the Palm Beach County Supervisor of Elections office in West Palm Beach. The president had spent the morning at a nearby golf course before casting his vote. Trump has previously faced criticism for voting by mail despite repeatedly attacking the practice. Asked whether he had voted for candidates from his own party, he replied, "Very much so."

title: Suspicious pigeon with coded ring, Pak currency causes a flutter in Jammu
content: An official pointed out that such episodes are not uncommon in border areas of J&K and Punjab, where pigeons have been used for smuggling or for sending messages across the frontier. On Saturday, the pigeon was found near a temple in Samba’s border area of Mawa around 6.40am and was immediately captured by locals after they spotted a ring tied to its leg.

title: Ohio court upholds bank's right to foreclose after 3 loan modifications
content: In a recent decision, an Ohio appeals court upheld the foreclosure ruling against Sandra Doberdruk, stemming from her unpaid mortgage. Doberdruk's financial troubles escalated after her husband's passing in 2009, despite her attempts to modify her loan thrice. Wells Fargo eventually moved forward with foreclosure after missed payments, and the court ruled that her late husband's estate was not a necessary party in the proceedings.

title: Dallas insurer paid $4,261 for floor damage; court rejects $58,150 claim
content: A federal appeals court has ruled against Dallas residents who sought over $58,000 from State Farm for water damage from a 2021 freeze, determining that their lawsuit was not filed within the required timeframe of their insurance policy. State Farm had already compensated for initial damages but denied further claims, especially since the homeowners declined additional living costs during property repairs.

title: Rocket Mortgage founder turns $1 billion Detroit pledge into nonprofit fund
content: Billionaire Dan Gilbert announces a remarkable $1 billion investment aimed at revitalizing Detroit's Renaissance Center and nearby riverfront. This project will be overseen by a nonprofit organization that emphasizes community benefits with no profits going to Gilbert. The plan includes the creation of modern housing and a vibrant walkable district complete with parks and entertainment venues.

title: Defer Nov 1 rally, will hit festive business, traders urge Rahul; BJP raps Congress
content: CTI chairman Brijesh Goyal said Delhi records Rs 25,000 crore in business on Dhanteras across major sectors. CTI claimed that traders suffered losses of Rs 3,000 crore in Oct due to rallies and road closures in Connaught Place, India Gate and central Delhi. BJP claimed some Congress allies have disagreed with Rahul Gandhi’s decision to hold the rally on Nov 1.

title: Daughter’s inheritance rights can’t be defeated by limitation: J&K and Ladakh HC
content: The dispute dates back to Sept 14, 1982, when Themu, daughter of late Sonu, filed a civil suit claiming half share in land measuring 58 kanals and 11 marlas left behind by her father. She challenged mutation no. 43 dated Oct 15, 1966, which had been entered exclusively in favour of one Shib Devi and sought declaration of her inheritance rights along with consequential possession.

title: Natalia Granada reveals how her family inspired her F1 Academy journey
content: Natalia Granada takes her first plunge into the F1 Academy, marking a pivotal chapter in her racing narrative. With her family's enthusiasm for Formula 1 as her driving force, she transitioned from go-karting into the fast lane. Juggling education with rigorous training, she receives backing from the Iron Dames organization.

title: How Ons Jabeur went from hotel tennis courts to Grand Slam finals
content: Ons Jabeur’s journey from makeshift courts in hotels in Tunisia to three Grand Slam singles finals is a tale of years of determination, family sacrifice and belief in her distinctive playing style. Jabeur, the first Arab woman to play in a Grand Slam singles final, has broken with tennis tradition and set the stage for young players from Tunisia, North Africa and the wider Arab world.

title: CBI files FIR against IL&FS Energy, top execs in Rs 212cr Canara Bank loan fraud case
content: CBI has named M/s IL&FS Energy Development Company Ltd, its MD and directors — Sunil Wadhwa, Anoop Seth, Hari Sankaran, Ramesh Chandra Bawa and Arun Kumar Saha — and unknown public servants and private individuals as accused. The case was registered on Oct 21 following a complaint by Canara Bank’s circle office in Bandra.

title: Govt to explore ways to draw desi researchers back to India: Piyush Goyal
content: After meeting a group of Indian researchers in Berlin Friday, Goyal said the challenge goes beyond financial incentives to creating a supportive ecosystem for research and innovation. He intended to discuss the issue with govt, educational institutions, academia, research institutions and industry in order to forge stronger partnerships, he said.

title: Congress alleges attack on Christian families in Bengal, writes to Amit Shah
content: Congress general secretary K C Venugopal has written to Union Home Minister Amit Shah and West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari, on Saturday, seeking urgent action over the alleged assault, humiliation and coercion of three Christian families in Patlapur village of Paschim Medinipur district during Durga Puja celebrations.

title: ED moves Supreme Court against HC order to quash case against portal, founder
content: The directorate, which filed an appeal almost five months after the HC pronounced the order on May 29, also took the ground that the HC passed the order five months and 26 days after the judgement was reserved and it was in violation of SC’s guidelines that the verdict should be delivered within three months.

title: Rs 10 lakh cover for 45 paise: Counter rail ticket buyers get insurance option
content: The scheme has provision for payment of Rs 7.5 lakh for permanent partial disability and up to Rs 2 lakh for hospitalisation expenses arising from injuries, as well as Rs 10,000 towards transportation of mortal remains of deceased passengers. The Railway Board has directed all its zones to implement the facility.

title: Set to expand cabinet, J&K CM Omar asks hopefuls not to ‘mob or spam’ him
content: J&K CM Omar Abdullah advised them against knocking on his doors or that of his father and National Conference president, Dr Farooq Abdullah, to lobby for ministerial positions. After meeting Sinha, Omar told reporters he sought an appointment with him for next week so that he can make changes and expand his council of ministers.

title: Over 4 lakh march across country, nearly 1,000 arrested - France protests in videos
content: In France, protesters took to the streets, decrying the plight of underfunded schools and spiraling living expenses. This unrest sparked violent confrontations with the police in major cities like Paris and Lyon, where authorities resorted to tear gas and water cannons. As arrests mounted, President Macron's administration faces an escalating challenge, with students and teachers uniting to demand improvements in education and address deep-seated economic disparities affecting their communities.

title: 'Act of treason': BJP guns for Farooq Abdullah over 'Pak protecting Kashmiris' remark
content: In recent developments, BJP leaders have taken strong issue with Farooq Abdullah's comments regarding Pakistan's alleged support for Kashmiris. Abdullah, speaking at a workers' gathering, cast doubt on the central government's approach to Jammu and Kashmir, raising questions about India's commitment to justice. In response, BJP representatives charged him with treason, claiming his remarks weaken India's stance on the issue.

title: 'Can no longer breathe': Thousands protest in Turkey over media crackdown
content: Thousands demonstrated in Istanbul and Ankara to oppose the government's increasing restrictions on independent media and journalists. Protesters called for press freedom, chanting slogans that emphasized their demand for basic rights. Various media professionals have been arrested recently, raising concerns about freedom of speech in Turkey. Journalists and activists participated in these rallies to highlight the public's right to information.

title: Fake faces, stolen voices, false stories: Can we still trust what we see online?
content: Recent incidents highlight how Artificial Intelligence can create deceptive videos and audio that mislead individuals. Eye-witness accounts and authentic recordings can no longer be trusted without verification. High-profile figures have been especially targeted in various scams that exploit technology. It is essential for individuals to adopt cautious practices to combat misinformation effectively. Building digital awareness will help in preserving trust and accountability in online interactions.

title: Delhi school death: Police recover 3-page suicide note, breakup angle under probe
content: An 18-year-old Class 12 student was found burnt on her school premises in Krishna Nagar, Delhi. Police recovered a three-page suicide note, which mentioned family and a friend. Investigators are examining potential motives, including a possible breakup or conspiracy. Family members express disbelief at the possibility of suicide and suspect foul play. The police are pursuing leads and reviewing CCTV footage to understand the circumstances surrounding her death.

title: 'We are fed up, Macron must give in': Protests erupt across France; cops use tear gas
content: France is taking significant measures to manage mounting tensions, deploying around 70,000 police officers to supervise protests over education funding and escalating living costs. In response to previous violent outbreaks, authorities have restricted protest routes. Major Parisian museums and shops have temporarily closed to prevent potential chaos as demands for enhanced educational opportunities, better salaries, and improved public services grow.

title: 'Boys becoming men': Gambhir's message after Tilak-Nitish pull off thrilling chase
content: In an impressive display, India clinched a stunning four-wicket victory over New Zealand in the second T20I at Christchurch, taking a pivotal 2-0 lead in the series. After a wobbly middle order, Tilak Varma and Nitish Kumar Reddy stepped up in the chase, while Naman Dhir's quick 31 runs helped stabilize the innings.

title: BFI power struggle deepens ahead of October 28 meeting; Boxing fraternity calls for unity
content: Indian boxing is currently undergoing administrative disputes amid a potential no-confidence motion against president Ajay Singh. Key figures in boxing are urging for stability and accountability to protect the sport's growth. An ad-hoc committee has been formed in Jharkhand to address the local association's election issues. BFI secretary general Pramod Kumar has proposed the no-confidence motion to be considered soon.

title: Haryana student beaten with iron rods; CCTV captures 50 blows in a minute
content: Rudra, a BBA student, suffered severe injuries after being attacked by three men following a motorcycle collision. The incident occurred around 7 pm near Hudda Park in Bhiwani district, causing multiple fractures and serious injuries. CCTV footage reportedly shows the assailants attacking Rudra with sticks and an iron rod while he attempted to escape. His family believes the assault was linked to a previous altercation involving his elder brother Dhruv.

title: ‘What’s with the hate?’: Kriti Sanon reacts to backlash over her Raksha Bandhan ad outfit
content: Kriti Sanon, trolled in August over her “revealing” outfit in a GIVA Raksha Bandhan ad, says her choli became a “national debate.” Speaking to Kareena Kapoor Khan, she said women are scrutinised for everything, criticised those preaching culture while abusing her family online, and added women simply want to not be judged.

title: Pollard doesn't want to see 'yellows and reds', urges MI to put 'team above self'
content: Pollard, who was Mumbai Indians' batting coach for the last four IPL seasons, takes over from Mahela Jayawardene, who parted ways with the franchise last week. The former West Indies all-rounder has been associated with MI since IPL 2010, when he was signed as a player.

title: 45 paise for Rs 10L cover: Rlys extends insurance to counter tickets from Oct 27
content: Starting October 27, Indian Railways will provide travelers the option to include an Optional Travel Insurance Scheme with their reservation ticket purchases. For a nominal fee of just 45 paise, passengers gain crucial coverage for accident-related incidents. The insurance offers various payout options tailored to medical and logistical emergencies. Reservation staff will be responsible for informing ticket buyers about this crucial add-on before finalizing bookings.

title: Tensions mount at Jamia: Classes shift online; AISA alleges assault on students
content: "All Deans/Heads/Directors and faculty members as well as all bonafide students are hereby directed to adhere to the online class schedule and ensure regular participation in academic activities. All faculty members are requested to make the necessary arrangements for conducting classes through online platforms and to provide students with the required academic support and learning materials," the notice read.

title: Palace, Siblings And A 'Kansa Mama' Jibe: Jagan Reddy-Sister Row Over Wedding
content: Anjili Reddy is set to marry Dr Somala Raghuram Reddy. The wedding is planned for November 25, with a reception in Hyderabad on December 5. Sharmila personally invited several guests to the Bengaluru event.

title: India Issues Fresh Advisory For Umrah Pilgrims In Saudi Arabia
content: The mission also said it remained in regular contact with Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Hajj and Umrah and Ministry of Foreign Affairs to address difficulties caused by the flight disruptions, particularly issues concerning visa validity and delayed departures.

content: The agency contended that high court quashed its case without examining the money laundering case, and there was an inordinate delay of five months in the pronouncement of the judgment.

content: Siddaramaiah had on Friday termed the alleged sting operation targeting him as "totally concocted", saying it was intended to blackmail him and demanded a fair investigation to bring out the truth and identify those behind it.

title: Repolling At 3 Booths In Agra Tomorrow For Legislative Council Polls
content: The voting that took place at these specific polling stations on October 23 has been declared void under Section 58A(2)(a) of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, a press release issued by the Chief Electoral Officer's office said.

title: "Welcome Move For Aviation Sector": Vijay Gets Rare Praise From Centre
content: Vijay's government had yesterday cut the value added tax (VAT) on aviation turbine fuel (ATF) from 29% to 16% at Chennai airport and to 1% at other airports in the state.

content: Some 200 firefighters were mobilised for the operation at the Kehlsteinhaus residence on a summit above Obersalzberg in southern German.

content: On Saturday, around 30 men brought out the idol that had drawn large crowds to one of the most artistic Durga Puja pandals this year in Kolkata. The pandal remains sealed for investigation.

content: Mumbai's pollution levels were driven by a combination of construction dust, sluggish wind speed, garbage burning, emissions from crop fires in surrounding regions, and residual smoke from firecrackers.

content: Gunmen entered the compound of a Greek Orthodox church in Hammoud village during a funeral procession on Friday and opened fire, authorities said.

content: The closures came a week after nationwide demonstrations over the cost of living and deteriorating public services led to clashes between protesters and authorities.

content: The email carried the subject line "Bombs Placed in Your Building", prompting police to launch an investigation amid a recent spate of bomb-threat emails targeting schools in Delhi.

content: veteran actor criticizes BJP-led government in west Bengal . Naseeruddin Shah is an opponent of the Bharatiya Janata Party and the Sangh . his daughter is married in Kolkata; she is the daughter-in-law of a leader .

title: Amit Shah visits Delhi Police HQ amid law and order concerns in Capital
content: the visit comes amid heightened scrutiny of the police over allegations of excessive force against protesters during the Cockroach Janata Party's 'Sansad Chalo' march in July . the visit marks Shah's return to the Delhi Police headquarters after more than four years .

title: Kerala Blasters get Kochi stadium for ISL home matches at Rs 3.5 lakh per game
content: the government allotted the Jawaharlal Nehru International Stadium in Kochi to Kerala Blasters FC for their home matches in the 2026-27 Indian Super League (ISL) season at a rent of Rs 3.5 lakh per match . the order was issued by the local self government department a day before the club are scheduled to host Mumbai City FC in their first home match of the season .

title: US midterms: At Florida rally, Trump vows action against Cuba after Iran war
content: president Donald Trump has said he will turn his attention to Cuba once the war with Iran is settled . his remarks come as his administration continues to tighten pressure on the Cuban government . he reiterated that further military action against Iran could be possible as the administration grapples with rising oil prices .

title: 'Islamabad arming Afghans to fight anti-Pak insurgents': Ex-US envoy sounds alarm
content: the allegations come amid worsening ties between Islamabad and Kabul . envoy says relations between Pakistan and Afghanistan are likely to get much worse . reports that pakistan is recruiting Afghans to fight anti-Pakistan insurgents .

title: ‘Sri Lanka, Bangladesh happen when protests are not allowed’: Sonam Wangchuk

title: The unbearable weight of grief in John Wick is very familiar to our times
content: action was just a tool When John Wick hit theaters on October 24, 2014 . most of us expected the film to be another slick, gun-heavy action movie . is it that the movie stirred something so deep and visceral in us that we didn’t see coming?

title: 1798 Massachusetts mansion bought for $2.16m later sold for city-record $5.2m
content: the grand estate has now changed hands for $5.2 million, setting a new residential sales record for the city . built in 1798 for a merchant and shipbuilder, the grand federal-era property has changed hands . the mansion sold for $2.16 million in 2016 before an extensive restoration and expansion reshaped the property .

title: 'US will try to seize island': Iran bracing for attack before Oct 27 Israeli polls
content: a senior Iranian official tells drop site that Tehran's internal intelligence assessment indicated a high likelihood of large-scale bombing beginning before Tuesday's Israeli elections . the white house has denied plans to attack Iran before the US midterm elections, according to a report cited by drop site .

title: Riyadh, Dammam, Jeddah flights hit: Air India, IndiGo extend suspensions
content: flights to and from Riyadh and Dammam will remain suspended until 7 November 2026 . services connecting jeddah will remain cancelled until 31 October 2026, the consulate says . escalating tensions in the region have affected travellers, including Indian Umrah pilgrims .
